en-US.author: Boris Kudriashov
en-US.description: A tiny native Windows terminal for AI coding agents
en-US.longDescription:
agliteterm is a minimal Windows terminal for old or low-RAM machines: one small C++ exe
(Win32/WTL, no .NET runtime) over the same Rust emulator core and pty-host as agwinterm, with
real native controls instead of custom-drawn chrome.

Workspaces and sessions carry per-session agent status (bold = blocked, italic = working), an
attention bell that jumps to the next blocked session, flagged sessions and unread badges. It
speaks the same newline-JSON control API as agwinterm — 41 verbs, driven by the same
agwintermctl client — and sets the same AGWINTERM_* session variables, so scripts, hooks and the
agent skill work in both. A shared conformance suite runs in both repositories' CI.

The look is classic Windows: menu bar, toolbar, TreeView sidebar, status bar, Dark / Light /
Classic / Auto themes, bundled bitmap fonts, an MS-DOS palette and a cmd.exe-style Properties
dialog.

If your machine can afford it, take agwinterm instead — it is the fuller terminal. agliteterm
exists for the machines that cannot.
en-US.name: agliteterm
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
- session text --styles: styled runs from the same rows as plain text (#102) by @yeroo in #105
- install hooks: give Codex real status hooks through ~/.codex/hooks.json by @yeroo in #106
- install: refuse only link-type reparse points so OneDrive profiles get the block by @yeroo in #108
- CI: build the shared agwintermctl from agwinterm v0.20.11 by @yeroo in #111
- session type/paste: answer inside 30 s and say how far a stopped write got by @yeroo in #112
- fetch-native: stage agwintermctl from its own cliTag pin, and CI with the same binary by @yeroo in #113
- notify: categories (ok | normal | attention) and configurable pill colours (#114) by @yeroo in #115
- install hooks: a SessionStart hook binds the pane to its live Claude or Codex session (#118) by @yeroo in #119
- Shell exit: the exit code, a notice when out of view, and a hold until Enter (#116) by @yeroo in #117
- native: core ABI 19, and Microsoft's ConPTY as an opt-in, so programs can ask the terminal (#120) by @yeroo in #121
- release: prepare agliteterm 0.20.10 by @yeroo in #122
